title: usenet-ipfs-mail: JMAP core protocol
description:
Implement the RFC 8620 core protocol layer: serde types for Request/Response/Invocation/error objects, session resource endpoint (GET /jmap/session), /.well-known/jmap redirect, and method dispatch table that routes JMAP method invocations to registered handlers.

Why: JMAP clients require the session resource to discover capabilities and API URLs before making any method calls.

How to apply: all Mailbox and Email sub-epics depend on this dispatcher.
